large, super-stocked store, but always check your receipt. I've had a couple of problems with discounts. The staff is excellent, but the checkouts are disorganized and the prices don't always match the product.

I'd been there last summer, and then again an hour ago. I'd never seen such rudeness: they don't say hello when you come in or even when you leave. If you ask for something, the answer is "it's over there." Unpleasant welcome, unpleasant staff, and a complete disregard for the customer. I'll never set foot in there again.

Well stocked... For dogs and cats, though! Those who choose to have other pets will find very little. They've completely reduced the rodent section, offering very little choice. Something for bird owners.

I went today around 1pm for the first time. I had to buy some kibble for my friend's cat and for mine. The girl, as soon as she finished serving a customer, approached us and told us that if we needed anything, we could ask without any problem. Since we couldn't find the kibble for my friend, we asked her. She was sorry and told us that they didn't have that product and immediately offered to look at another nearby Arcaplanet, the one on Viale Umbria. They only had one pack, and Sara (the girl at the store) called the other one to reserve it for us. I'd say fantastic!!! Only at this point did we ask for the one for our cat, also asking for information since it's a product that has just come out. And she was very professional and knowledgeable. And in the meantime, she also served another customer with a special request. Really compliments to Sara. Then we went to the Arcaplanet on Viale Umbria where the super kind girl had already prepared our kibble at the checkout. Truly excellent service.

I've often ordered online and picked them up at this store, and I've always been satisfied. The products were intact, no missing pieces, and the staff were always helpful and courteous. This time, I found the litter box deodorizer in its paper packaging, sealed with tape full of "balls," scattered throughout the bag (which I noticed once I got home because the package had been opened at the store and I purchased other products). Now, while it's true that we're talking about a litter box deodorizer, you simply can't sell products that you've already OPENED and SEALED WITH TAPE (which, incidentally, had tons of product balls stuck to it, and many were lost, reducing the actual amount I PAID for). I called the store twice to find out what to do, but I didn't receive a response.
